items.title: A PLEA FOR GUIDANCE
items.quote: Hashem, who is worthy of being in Your tent?
items.text: Ask Hashem to guide you in doing what is needed to please Him and maintain an ongoing closeness with Him.
“[1] He walks in perfect innocence. Observe the mitzvos of Hashem whole-heartedly and sincerely, without consciously interpreting their meaning to suit your convenience
items.title: SINCERITY
FAIRNESS
items.text: Act charitably toward your fellow man and make sure not to cause him harm or pain.

items.title: TRUTH
items.quote: [3] He speaks the truth in his heart.
items.text: Let your spoken words conform to what is in your heart.”

items.title: NO GOSSIP
items.quote: [4] He has no gossip on his tongue.
items.text: Don’t reveal private information, even if true, and even if seemingly innocent.”

items.title: NO HARM
items.quote: [5] He does no harm to his fellow.
items.text: Avoid actions that cause financial or emotional harm to others.”

items.title: NO INSULT
items.quote: [6] He does not embarrass his close relative.
items.text: Don’t insult another person or embarrass him in any way. Treat him as though he were your close relative, with whom you want to maintain a long-lasting friendly relationship.”

items.title: NO FLATTERING
items.quote: [7] In his eyes, a person who is contemptible [because of his sins], is repulsive.
items.text: Don’t flatter a sinful person, even if he is rich and powerful.”

items.title: RESPECT
items.quote: [8] He honors those who fear Hashem.
items.text: Be respectful towards individuals who are occupied with learning Torah and doing good deeds.”

items.title: STAY COMMITTED
items.quote: [9] He takes an oath to his own [physical] detriment and he does not retract it.
items.text: If you make a vow to desist from a material pleasure, don’t weaken your commitment.”

items.title: NO INTEREST
items.quote: [10] He does not lend his money at interest.
items.text: If you lend someone money, don’t charge him interest.”

items.title: NO BRIBES
items.quote: [11] He does not take a bribe to favor an innocent [party].
items.text: If you have the duty of judging a situation don’t accept a bribe of any kind, even if you are convinced it will not affect your judgement.
